about_the_game:
DEMO

Experience this short demo for STONED! This demo includes the first area of the game, fully playable from start to finish, as well as some small extra-content from the final game. It's only a small part of the story, see if you like it!

STORY

STONED is a turn-based RPG about 3 stoners named Lil Bro, Big Bro and Cole who accidentally become possessed by the soul of an Ancient Cosmic Wizard. This leads to them finding out they have a prophesised duty to resurrect the Cosmic Wizard from the dead. But since they're too lazy to do all that, they decide to go on an adventure to find and collect 3 magical stones that can be used in a ritual to remove the Wizard's soul from them. Shenanigans ensue.

UNIQUE TURN-BASED GAMEPLAY

STONED features unique "pong-style" attack mechanics in its battle system in order to make the traditional turn-based combat more interactive and input based! You avoid enemy attacks by aligning yourself with their projectile and performing a certain action based on it's colour in order to deflect it!

OTHER FEATURES

  • Mix of traditional and unique turn-based combat mechanics

  • Party-based RPG mechanics

  • Unique story with both comedic and emotional themes

  • Exploration of new areas with lots of items to find and NPCs to talk to

  • Magical spells and other fantasy themes

  • Weed

A WORD FROM THE CHARACTERS!

COLE SAYS:

"Please play this game so I can purchase some more loud"

DISCLAIMER: STONED features depictions and glorification of illicit drug use and addiction. However, Team Quivurr does not condone or endorse the illegal use of substances. This game is a work of fiction, and the actions of its characters are not intended as social commentary or advice of any kind.

A Turn-Based RPG with a unique story and "pong-style" battle mechanics. This is a short demo of the first area in STONED!
